scenarios.name: own-turn-spell-untaxed-even-with-opponents-grid
scenarios.why: Seat 0 casts during its own turn. The artifact does not increase the cost merely because the opponent controls it; one red mana pays for Bolt.

scenarios.name: opponent-turn-spell-needs-three-extra
scenarios.why: Seat 1 holds priority during seat 0's turn. Bolt costs three generic mana beyond its red symbol, so one red mana cannot pay for it.

scenarios.name: opponent-turn-spell-castable-at-full-tax
scenarios.why: Four red mana pays both the red symbol and all three generic mana of the off-turn increase, leaving the pool empty.
